claude_proposed_widenings.name: substitute_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive property lets the wielder substitute Lightning for Piercing damage on every qualifying hit. No existing EffectAtom covers outgoing damage-type substitution. It is not 'damage' (which emits a damage instance), not 'modify_damage_numeric' (which adjusts amounts), not 'grant_resistance' (which reduces incoming damage), and not expressible via on_hit_trigger because MasteryEffect is too narrow (only ModifyRollAdvantageRider | SaveGateRider | GrantWeaponAttackRider).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor.line with dynamic length (self-to-target)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bolt's line length equals the distance from caster to target (variable, up to 120 ft). The current AreaShapeDescriptor.line requires a fixed lengthFeet. The encoding approximates with lengthFeet=120 (max); a dynamic 'length = distance to target' variant would be the honest shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Immediately after the Lightning Bolt resolves, the javelin reappears in the wielder's hand. No existing EffectAtom or lifecycle atom models 'item returns to holder immediately after activation'. The closest candidate, return_on_end, is tied to spell duration end — not immediate post-activation return.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: area self-exclusion flag on Attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The line area explicitly excludes the caster. The current area Attachment has occupantDispositionFilter (friendly/hostile) but no way to exclude the source creature specifically.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target and each other creature in the Line (excluding you) makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.
